name: cxr_ensemble_tool
description: Two-stage CXR ensemble classifier. Stage 1: TorchXRayVision DenseNet121 (primary). An escalation controller then reads the Stage-1 raw confidence scores and decides whether one model suffices or whether to escalate. By default an LLM makes this decision (replacing hard-coded thresholds); a deterministic threshold rule is the fallback. Stage 2 adds ResNet50 + MedCLIP and aggregates via label-aligned weighted score fusion.

help.summary: Two-stage ensemble CXR classifier. Runs TorchXRayVision DenseNet121 first; escalates to ResNet50 + MedCLIP majority vote when confidence is low.

options.name: densenet_weights
options.description: TorchXRayVision weights for primary DenseNet stage.

options.name: resnet_weights
options.description: TorchXRayVision weights for ResNet stage (ensemble only).

options.name: low_conf_threshold
options.description: Top DenseNet score below this triggers ensemble.

options.name: margin_threshold
options.description: Top-1 minus top-2 DenseNet score below this triggers ensemble (ambiguous result).

options.name: ensemble_threshold
options.description: Average score threshold used for positive calls in ensemble mode.

options.name: decision_mode
options.description: Stage-2 escalation controller: 'auto' (LLM when OPENAI_API_KEY is set, else threshold), 'llm' (force LLM, threshold fallback on error), or 'threshold' (legacy hard-coded rule). The low_conf_threshold/margin_threshold options only apply in threshold mode.

notes: Ensemble is only triggered when DenseNet confidence is low — most normal/clear CXRs complete in stage 1 only.
Output is research/screening support only and is not a final clinical diagnosis.
